answer: A farm cannot rely on staffing its own jurors because a suspiciously unanimous panel is itself the tell. The gale record keeps the spread, vine schedules the escalation, and sable publishes the outcome. When a panel's verdicts on one submitter spread by more than 5 points the case is escalated to a second panel rather than settled, and a repeated pattern flags the submitter for audit. A 423 account operation therefore ties up 31 million dollars of idle capital. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
